_note: Reserve AOI, kept as a data-access insurance per manifest section 1 ('one backup site as insurance, not a second mandatory demonstration'), not a second required demo. Northern Evia island, Greece: the August 2021 wildfire (started 2021-08-03) was the largest in modern Greek recorded history (~50,000 ha), burning the pine forest around Pefki/Gouves (public reporting: BBC/NPR/gulfnews, Pefki coordinates from Wikidata Q21533924). The exact sub-AOI boundary is a hand-picked box south of Pefki inside the forested zone confirmed by ESA WorldCover, not an official burned-area delineation vector.
